Chapter Ten: Sustaining Wellbeing—Lifelong Practice and Growth.
If you’ve been exploring Chinese astrology as a path to better health and self-understanding, you probably already know—it isn’t about reaching some perfect end point. Instead, it’s a lifelong practice. Just like you, it grows and changes over time.
Let’s start with regular self-assessment. Think about how the seasons shift—sometimes gently, sometimes with a jolt. Your elemental needs work the same way. So, at the start of each new season, take a few moments to check in with yourself. How’s your health? How’s your mood? Are your daily routines truly supporting you right now? If anything feels off, tweak your practices so they match what you need in this moment.
And those big life transitions—like getting older, changing careers, or shifts in your family? They often call for a fresh approach. Don’t be afraid to review and update your strategies as you move through these chapters.
Remember, wellbeing isn’t something you have to do alone. It’s actually much richer when it’s shared. Reach out to people who are also interested in holistic health or Chinese astrology. Maybe you’ll join a group practice, or just chat with a friend who gets it. And, when you hit a tricky patch, consider seeking out a practitioner who can help you interpret your chart and suggest some personalized steps.
But here’s something really important: perfection isn’t the goal. There will be days—or even weeks—when things feel out of balance. Maybe you stumble, or you’re just not sure what you need. That’s okay. The real magic happens when you approach these moments with patience, and an open mind. Each little setback is a chance to learn more about yourself, and to fine-tune your approach.
Don’t forget to celebrate the wins, too. Even the small ones. Every step toward harmony is worth noticing and honoring.
So, what is health, really, in this way of thinking? It’s less about rigid rules, and more like a dance—a dance with nature’s rhythms and your own unique makeup. If you stay curious, flexible, and gentle with yourself, you’ll find you can sustain wellbeing, no matter what life throws your way.
